text.start:
GnomeVPN — a VPN on Hysteria2.

To link this chat to your subscription, open the App tab on the site and press Link Telegram. A code appears — send it here.

No account yet? Sign up on the site and the subscription shows up here by itself.
text.linked: Done — this chat is linked to your subscription.
text.alreadyLinked: This chat is already linked to a subscription.
text.codeInvalid: That code did not work: it is unknown, already used or expired. Get a new one on the site.
text.notLinked: This chat is not linked to a subscription. Send the code from the site — the App tab.
text.unlinked: Chat unlinked. Your subscription and access are untouched.
text.noSubscription: No subscription yet. Get one with /buy
text.linkIntro: Your subscription URL — add it to the app as a subscription:
text.linkWarning: Do not forward it: the link is the credential. If it leaks, rotate it on the site.
text.trialGranted: Your trial day is active. Your subscription URL — /link
text.trialUnavailable: The trial has already been used, or a subscription is running.
text.trialNeedsEmail: Confirm your email address on the site first — the message goes to the address on the account.
text.checkoutIntro: Pay at the link below. Access opens the moment the payment clears.
text.inactive: No active subscription. Get one with /buy
text.help:
/status — expiry and devices
/link — your subscription URL
/trial — a free day
/buy — subscribe or renew
/language — change language
/unlink — unlink this chat
/help — this list
text.failed: Something went wrong. Try again later, or write to support.
